attribution.note: Marcus states the characterization in his own voice, separately from the quoted news report.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the statement's scope. Temporary describes the restriction's legal status, not a forecast of its duration.

contract.note: Distinguishing restrictions on public ChatGPT deployment from a general research prohibition is a fair ordinary reading. The statement need not imply that research using covered personal data was exempt.

evidence.note: The contemporaneous operative order establishes a provisional restriction on OpenAI's ChatGPT-related processing of personal data concerning people in Italy. It imposes no general research prohibition, although covered research processing receives no exemption.

The regulator's contemporaneous official announcement confirms the temporary restriction and platform-related processing scope. Its discussion of training data qualifies any stronger reading that all research processing was exempt.

reviews.rationale: The order and official explanation support a provisional restriction targeting ChatGPT-related personal-data processing rather than AI research generally. The absence of a research exemption does not defeat the contract's fair ordinary reading. Both sources were published before the evaluation cutoff.
